intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hastings for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The season opens November 28 with Holiday Hoopla in downtown Hastings and the Community Tree Lighting at City Hall, then the CPKC Holiday Train rolls into Depot Park on December 12. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hastings

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Hastings
  • 1 free event: the CPKC Holiday Train concert at Depot Park on December 12
  • Meet Santa: see the Holiday Hoopla listing
  • Parades and tree lightings: Community Tree Lighting at Hastings City Hall, November 28
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm
  • Season: November 28 to December 12, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Hastings families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers Hastings' Holiday Hoopla and the CPKC Holiday Train.
celebrates: Hastings kicks off the season on Small Business Saturday, November 28, when the Hastings Downtown Business Association hosts Holiday Hoopla with Breakfast with Santa at Lock and Dam Eatery, horse and wagon rides on 2nd Street from noon to 4 pm and cookie decorating at the 2nd Street Depot from 11 am to 2 pm. The day closes with the community tree lighting at City Hall at 5:30 pm, according to the City of Hastings. On December 12 the CPKC Holiday Train brings a free concert to Depot Park.
lastyear: The Hastings Downtown Business Association and the City of Hastings both list their 2026 Small Business Saturday plans, with the tree lighting placed at the end of the Holiday Hoopla schedule. We did not find a published recap of the 2025 Holiday Hoopla or a city write up of last year's CPKC Holiday Train visit, so this page leaves out 2025 numbers. The city's events page describes this year's train as a decorated train with a free concert by Allen Stone.
facts: The CPKC Holiday Train stop in Hastings is at Depot Park, listed by Explore Minnesota at 500 East Second Street, on Saturday, December 12, from 8:45 to 9:15 pm. The City of Hastings describes a decorated train and a free holiday concert by Allen Stone. The Holiday Hoopla schedule also includes a stop at the 2nd Street Depot, where cookie decorating runs from 11 am to 2 pm.
trains: Hastings is on the CPKC Holiday Train route this year. The decorated train stops at Depot Park on Saturday, December 12, from 8:45 to 9:15 pm for a free concert by Allen Stone, according to the City of Hastings. Cottage Grove's stop follows on December 13 at 5:15 pm, and Saint Paul Union Depot's on December 13 at 7 pm, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum in Saint Paul runs a Saturday train ride from its roundhouse.
train_links: Fills the 1907 Jackson Street Roundhouse, with a train ride on Saturdays.
